verdict.rationale: The evidence pack discusses llama.cpp's default mmap behavior and its performance effects (e.g., swapping, RAM reduction) but contains no documentation or community evidence of explicit flags (like --mlock, --no-mmap) that let a power-user override these low-level engine settings. missing for 10: CLI/docs citation of mlock/mmap override flags, any first-party reference to configurable memory-locking behavior, independent confirmation of such overrides being used.
